* This item allows you to temporarily change the binding status of one equippable item from [[Bound to Character]] to [[Bound to Account]] until re-equipped. 
* After equipped, the item once again becomes [[Bound to Character]]. 
* The Wish of Inheritance is a Single-use item and its effects cannot be used on non-equippable items such as the {{Item|Cursed Blade of Jack Jibbers}}.

{{Quote
|developer=Cordovan
|source={{Forums|p=6270432|display=0}}
|quote={{Snip}} Thrown weapons and quivers need additional work on our end to work with the Wish of Inheritance. Just hang onto your wish for now and it'll work in the near future.
}}

== Usage ==

The item you intend to use with the Wish of Inheritance cannot be equipped, and it cannot be locked in your inventory.

# Double-click the Wish to open up the recipes.
# Drag the item into the ingredients bar.
# Click '''Alter Bind Status'''.
